title: LandlordGuard Claims Manual Appendix: Payment Thresholds and Recovery Periods
content:
Three claim-payment figures of the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy, by tier: the replacement-cost amount per coverage part at or below which no depreciation is withheld, the days allowed to document repair for release of withheld depreciation, and the dwelling payment at or above which the mortgagee is named co-payee.

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Replacement-cost amount per coverage part at or below which no depreciation is withheld (USD) | 0 | 1,000 | 1,000 | 2,500 | 2,500 | 5,000 |
| Days after the actual-cash-value payment to document repair (calendar days) | 180 | 180 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Dwelling payment at or above which the mortgagee is named co-payee (USD) | 2,500.00 | 2,500.00 | 2,500.00 | 2,500.00 | 2,500.00 | 2,500.00 |

Plain figures: no-holdback thresholds 0, 1000, 1000, 2500, 2500 and 5000 USD; recovery periods 180, 180, 365, 365, 365 and 365 days; co-payee threshold 2500 USD on every tier.

## Points of judgement

- The no-holdback figure is compared per coverage part: a part whose replacement-cost amount is at or below it has nothing withheld. With a figure of 0 on LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic, the comparison does not arise in practice because that tier pays the dwelling at actual cash value.
- The co-payee threshold is inclusive: a hypothetical dwelling payment of exactly 2,500.00 USD names the mortgagee as co-payee when one is on file; 2,499.99 USD does not.
- The recovery period is 180 days on DP-1 Basic and DP-2 Broad and 365 days on the DP-3 tiers.
